title: Tōkai Power Station

buildingCutout.basis: Suppresses coincident generated geometry only at the mapped original main block during the historical date range.

terrainReference.basis: Original Japanese national elevation at the landward corner of the old station’s main building.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap exterior of the original Tōkai station, 104120199
mapIdentity.scope: Named OpenStreetMap feature 104120199 identifies the original main building, fixes its four exterior corners and gives the alignment of the historic public profile.

note: The exact Department of Energy aerial archive photograph shows the stand-alone original station before the second unit and establishes its stacked rectangular massing, rowed industrial hall facade and red-and-white chimney. Japan Atomic Power records the opening in July 1966. The Nuclear Regulation Authority describes the historic 89 m chimney before it was shortened.
